title: Dexcom Share as source?
symptom: The user wants to use xDrip watchfaces/complications but the official Dexcom app stops sending data to the watchface after a few readings. They prefer not to use xDrip as the main app because insurance/doctor require official Dexcom data.
fix: The thread indicates that the feature is implemented as 'Dex Share Follower' (comment by tolot27). No specific configuration steps are provided.
evidence_quote: It is implemented already as Dex Share Follower.
